contracts.contract: hard_resource_bounds.model_loads=0; CPU tokenizer encode allowed; NO model weight load.
Adds LANL L3A and distinct endpoints, says no other resource changes.

evidence.actual: hard_resource_bounds.model_loads=0; CPU tokenizer allowed but no full weight load

independent_source_findings.interpretation: CPU full model load is not a GPU forward, but conflicts with frozen G0 CPU workload contract. Model-weight load is 1 in each script if full render enabled, although no backbone forwards occur. Change to tokenizer-only native renderer or prospectively amend CPU resource allowance/memory and review before full G0.

evidence.actual: token report records per-arm length/first diff relative to old, not new-vs-neutral match; no matched label/stop
independently re-renders each arm, validates per-arm values but does not cross-compare new vs neutral length
Novelty contrast expressly requires matched-length neutral additions.

independent_source_findings.interpretation: CPU construction and oracle may still be informative, but an UNMATCHED neutral must not be counted as a format-controlled causal contrast. Add per-pair treatment-vs-neutral equality and explicit decision under predeclared thresholds before G1.

independent_source_findings.interpretation: Current quota reduction avoids the earlier prospective 160-forward scenario; 65 new/control arms is not the total physical pilot. evidence.actual: token re-render only if NOT skip-render
review status always PASS_A461_PSMI_G0_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION on successful partial flow

independent_source_findings.interpretation: For formal G0, either disallow --skip-render or emit distinct status PARTIAL_ORACLE_ONLY, and require token audit independently verified. Main phase1-only receipt already distinguishes partial.

evidence.actual: adds constant delta to all in-window failed-event ages; neither reorders list nor checks relation against success events
reapplies same delta; does not explicitly require original-vs-new event order preserved

independent_source_findings.interpretation: If added delta makes a failure event pass a success event in age order, original chronological sort may break; original rule semantics could stay same while native source-order contract fails. Check every N2 output for nonincreasing seconds across ALL events, not just fails, and record invalid or choose legal delta.
